row:
Hello,
      Most people don’t realize animals can benefit from chiropractic care too. I’m Dr Michele Morissette D.C., C.A.C., an animal chiropractor, and on this channel I show how I help animals move, recover, and thrive.”  I have been a chiropractor since 1989. I became a certified animal chiropractor in 2013.
I will also tell you how to optimize your animal's health and possibly add years to their life as well as life to their years.
I can show you how to tell if an animal needs chiropractic care. And how to help a dog recover from pain, limping, and even some cases of paralysis due to herniated discs.
